videos.title: Mushrooms for the Mind & Immune System | Paul Stamets
videos.description:
Paul Stamets is widely regarded as the father of modern applied mycology for his work on fungi and their applications in human health. We discuss how mushrooms and other fungi affect, and can improve, our immune system; how certain non-psychedelic mushrooms can enhance cognition and brain plasticity; and the use of psilocybin for depression, anxiety, and other mental health conditions, as well as important safety considerations. This episode is for anyone seeking to learn more about the biology of fungi and their medicinal and other uses.

videos.title: How I fight token fraud as an AI founder
videos.description:
Today I’m walking you through a problem that has cost me tens of thousands of dollars over the past year and eaten almost all of my engineering energy: token fraud. I’m the solo founder of ChatPRD, a bootstrapped AI platform for product managers, and fraudsters have been farming our free trials, reselling promo codes, wrapping the product in relays, and installing a custom MCP that ran as a 24/7 compute worker. I’ll walk through the six abuse patterns I’ve seen, the business and technical controls I put in place, the Jev loop that classifies fraud in real time, and why I finally killed free trials for good. If you sell AI, you sell compute.

*What you’ll learn:*
1. What token fraud is and why AI SaaS is uniquely exposed
2. The six attack patterns I’ve seen at ChatPRD
3. Why I finally turned off free trials for good
4. The Roblox and Fortnite maps I accidentally funded
5. Business controls that actually slow fraud down
6. How I use Jev to classify fraud in real time
7. Why your AI support desk can become an attack vector
8. What “if you sell AI, you sell compute” actually means

*Brought to you by:*
WorkOS—Make your app enterprise-ready, with SSO, SCIM, RBAC, and more: https://workos.com?utm_source=lennys_howiai&utm_medium=podcast&utm_campaign=q22025
Auros—The human network behind AI: https://aurosglobal.com/howiai

*In this episode, we cover:*
(00:00) Token fraud and what it cost me
(05:25) Six abuse patterns
(11:24) Four kinds of abusers
(13:45) Business controls
(21:27) Technical defenses
(30:25) Bots that watch the bots
(35:30) Final takeaways
